text: Fun games, good food. Pay with a card or exact change, probably should do this at most places anyways as it seems like it takes twice as long to settle a bill when you pay in cash.

Favorite neighborhood restaurant . They make my favorite bah mi in town. The pho ain't anything to knock either. Great food causal atmosphere. We also like the sushi rolls so there's something for everybody!

Cool looking place in a great location. Our server was extremely pleasant and attentive.  My issue is that when we were ready to pay our bill and leave, our server was tied up with a newly seated table who had a lot of questions. After waiting a few minutes and recognizing that she was still going to be tied up for a while, I ask another server if they would mind taking my payment.  They said "no" they could not and I would have to wait for my server. I explained that she was obviously going to be tied up for a while so perhaps they could ask the manager to take care of it for us. They agreed and handed my payment to a manager...who simply held on to it and waited (and waited, and waited, and waited) for our server to finally become available and then handed it to her.  That is terrible management and I will not come back for that simple reason.

Great food and entertainment, Al-don was a great chef and comedian.

I highly reccomended the kobe beef, the birthday deserts are excellent as well.

Waiting to get card for games on 9-26-2020. 
Service is terrible. I would highly recommend going anywhere else for entertainment.  Corporate should have their act together. It is ridiculous. Actually waiting at the desk and can't get a card. Terrible.

Delicious clam strip basket with yummy coleslaw and seasoned veggies.  The onion rings are gigantic and tasty.  The Grouper sandwiches ordered by my friends looked delicious as well.  Our server was very friendly and this place was a great start to our vacation.

Five. Five. Five can't even say it enough. This place exceeded so many expectations. It is exquisite all the way from the interior/ exterior decor, the service, to the food. The menu options were so great. I go the lamb, some Pinot Grigio and cheesecake for desert. I tried everyone's meals at the table and they were all phenomenal and everyone was pleased. Such a great place. Definitely a place to go if you're willing to spend a decent amount of money, but every penny is worth it. Our waitress recited every special perfectly, it truly is a remarkable restaurant.
We came on a Monday afternoon for a drink. We ended up leaving before we had the chance to order because the service was so slow.

Tried Aether last night for the first time. Great service!! Our server was knowledgeable and helpful with drinks and food. We got a lot of stuff & shared. 

Huge bar and great vibe In here. It's actually a lot bigger than it looks too. It's elegant but still relaxed. 

Started with Oysters - so fresh and yummy. Our sever explained them all to use east coast and west coast options. We went with the James river east coast. 

Salmon tartar was one of the best I've ever had! So fresh and clean!!!!! 

Shrimp toast was not my favorite. It was those mini shrimp which for me feel cheap, and the avocado underneath was barely there. Didn't taste bad, but compared to everything else. Eh. 

Brussels were great, charred and had a great peanut chili sauce on them. 
Spanish octopus was really good too. Has potatoes in it, almost a small full plate. 
All in all the food was really great here.

I give a 4/5 for 2 reasons...
1st - beers list isn't listed. Server has to tell you and you have no clue what you're paying for them. Not cheap just want to know if a beer is gonna be $5 or $10. 

2nd - same for the deserts - no list! The server tells you about them. They say for both they are rotating but they also have a little menu for the oysters. Wish they did the same for the beers. 

I'd say GO!!!!!! It's really amazing!!!

Amazing place for American-Korean food! Not a 100% authentic like you get in Northern Virginia, but the food itself is amazing, the environment was cozy and decor was charming!! The waitress was very friendly and knowledgeable of korean food and spices. Definitely get the kimchi and of course- Fried chicken!

One of our best meals in Santa Barbara. Awesome sandwiches here, grabbed the pastrami Rueben and the Italian sub that the wife and I shared on Friday evening. If they were open on Sunday we would have grabbed a couple of sandwiches for the drive home. Highly recommend.

I usually like this location, but for some reason this time I was given a steak that should have been well done, but clearly still had pink in the middle. Pics included. I ate what I could on the outside and left the rest. Shame I couldn't tell this until I made it back home. Not so sure how I'll feel about ordering steak from here next time.

Gold 'N Silver Inn is the very definition of an American diner--they don't get greasier, better, or more fun than this.  The food is typical diner fare: Lots of sandwiches, soups, salads, dessert, and entrees.  The portions are generous, and the prices are about what you'd expect for a place like this.  Good for families, though hold your breath while you go through the little casino area which is pungent with cig smoke.

Good drinks and music but please please please clean the bathrooms!! Pee city!! :( Didn't try the food, but it's a chain and has all the typical apps and sandwiches. Many other stops on Broadway to top this place.

Placed our 2nd online order tonight after liking our first time. Got the food all the way home and realized they didn't get the order right. Cheese on tacos when I requested no cheese. And we were short one taco. I mean come on, how hard is it? Check your order before you leave.

Honestly don't see what the hype is all about. Dark meat was bland & the fries were gross like the kind that's been in your freezer for too long. The tea has barely any ice so it's lukewarm. The worst part was the wait, we ordered to-go and the time they gave us for pick up was not when it was ready. 30 minutes after the time we finally got our bland food. not worth it!!

Y'all... 1) General manager is beyond nice.
2) I believe that chocolate cake is made to order, either way it came out moist, hot and is my new bestfriend.
3) Unique menu items are usually the most best ones... Just a tip.

Persis is my favorite Indian restaurant in the Nashville area.  I'm especially grateful that's it's in my town of Mt. Juliet. The dishes available are diverse and tasty.  The biryani and naan are the best I've ever had.  There are lots of vegetarian dishes, too and the chana masala is especially superb. We get a lot of takeout from here and since Covid delivery is now available through Door Dash.
I love this place! Coffee is amazing and the sandwiches are delicious! Staff is super friendly!
Solid New York pizza. Would happily return next time while in town. More of a take out spot. Limited seating.

Fresh seafood, creative rolls, Szechuan Seafood soup is delicious. Small place in strip mall. Reservations recommended. It's a BYOB and conveniently there is a pub with a good beer selection and a State store for your wine and Sake in the same shopping center.

We had an amazing night here on their new atrium room. Food was superb ing with the service. Our server was super knowledgeable. 

It felt so good to go out and have a normal night during this non normal time. The crab dip, some oysters,rack of lamb, monkfish and the tart was ordered. Everything was phenomenal. 

Dessert was Amazing choc. Chip pie and a white wedding. Need to visit More often. The new spot is AWESOME.

Like many Chic-fil-a restaurants, this one gets insanely busy at lunch and dinner. And the location right off of busy Baltimore Pike can add to the craziness. Still, having been at these times, the staff does a good job of keeping the customers moving in and out. The employees have been pretty professional in my experience, a pleasant change from the typical I-hate-my-job demeanor that you encounter in fast food joints. Breakfast time has relatively light traffic, so that is when I usually patronage the place. The food has been on point in my many visits.

Horrible decision to go here! I stopped  going years ago because of service. I was hoping with time they would get better. We went through the drive thru and the person on the intercom seemed totally disinterested. After we ordered the food, we come to the window and the person is drinking straight from the cup. Then, we get our food and the order is wrong and we didn't receive straws either! I guess the oersowanted us to drink directly from the cup too.

I went to Steve's Pizzeria a few weeks back MY GOD WHAT A DISGUSTING PLACE. Pizza is subpar and greasy with the worst service I have had in my life. If you saw the dirty tables and chairs then you would agree dining in was not a good option. It took way too long to get my food and on top of it they messed the order up.  I will NEVER go back to that Godawful place again.

This has got to be one of the best places I have ever eaten sushi. There were so many options, flavors and ideas! The wait was long but totally worth it. The flavors of the sushi were amazing. I will absolutely be going back and bringing many more people with me!

Stay AWAY!! Will never be back. Late lunch on Sunday. Two entree; Ft. Worth Ribeye and a Hamburger. The fries on the burger were not for human consumption, extremely salty at first then greasy on a second attempt. The steak was ok but, the side of buttered corn salty. Since when the corn need seasoning? Really? Not worth my money.Sorry, need significant improvement. Two stars because the service was average!
Great place to watch sunset on beach.  Food was great and servers helpful.  Avoid the wait at other places on the beach

This is a really neat cafe, it's really easy to miss as it is really tiny! There is a single table inside for about 6 people and a small bar. I had their 'Everything Nice' toast and it was really really good! I feel like the space is just a bit too small, a bit past cozy into the cramped side, and that is the only reason I'm giving this place 4 stars. But their food is really good and definitely worth a try!

Don't waste your money. The pizza arrived after waiting 1 hour so cold and needed to be reheated. After reheating,  it was like eating cardboard with rubber on top. It was completely tasteless and I am so disappointed that I wasted $32.00 on this garbage.
Delicious! Found this place by chance and I'm so glad we went. We don't live in the area so my only complaint is we won't be able to go back any time soon.

Pizza sauce is very sweet, meatballs were dry, green peppers were chopped like they would be on a frozen pizza, and dough was undercooked, for pizza I would not return, however the waitress was very accommodating even though she was the only one working on a fairly busy night(8 tables) and she was working the bar!

Been trying to get here for a very very long time.   In a word, Spectacular!    I've been a Philly cheesesteak disciple for decades and I've been to all of them.  This place is the best.  Even in a pandemic having to eat it in the car it couldn't have been better.   Get one with the onion and some pretty funny tee shirts while you're there.    Super nice staff  deep in the hood.    Loved it.

Another great hot pot meal at Nine Ting. It's still $24/pp for all you can eat. This time I came around 5:45pm on a Tuesday and there was no wait. By the time we left, it was way busier! 

Service was good, almost too good- I could almost feel the servers watching us, waiting to take our next order.. food came out in record time as well. 

Still highly recommend for crowds as they have charming guest rooms for privacy.

First time ordering this weekend, highly recommend! We got two ¼ pound sandwiches and lobster Mac and cheese. The steak was cooked perfectly and paired nicely with toppings and bun! It was ready within 15 and at less than $40 for 2 people was super reasonable.
Great portion servings. They have some kinks to work out in the delivery process, but I trust they will. Food tasted very fresh.
Ate breakfast here twice. Great Bloody Mary special, excellent menu, good prices for this area.

This was my first time here. My husband loves enchiladas so, decided to try Two Amigos. Everything taste very fresh and the service was quick. I prefer shredded chicken in my burritos but it was okay because everything was delicious and flavorful.

I am so sad to give this place 2 stars. I have been going to it for years but in the past 6 months I don't know if there is new ownership or what is going on but there is HORRIBLE customer service. Rude and unfriendly. First time they didn't give me any chips for my three meals that were included and when I asked the guy said "they don't come with the meal" I said yes they do (cuz they do) and he rolled his eyes and reached for them. Second time jus today we ordered (hoping it was just a random bad time) and again they put no chips in the meals. When my boyfriend asked for chips the lady said nothing and just gave them with no apologies or anything. What is going on there!!!

This place is a mixed bag with a lot of potential. The spot is nice, the menu looks good. The waiter was nice. But the front desk guy was putting off an odd vibe, the music was way too loud, and the fried chicken sandwich was very bland. Maybe Popeyes raised the bar with that new spicy fired chicken, but it's hard to figure out why to order this friend chicken. 

Bottom line it's probably a good spot if you live nearby, but not worth a drive from uptown.
Food was solid and Makayla killed it! Smart, attentive, moves with a sense of purpose and damn that ass  Best believe I'll be back

Very good food, well worth making the stop. They have very friendly employees, great service. The food was spot on, we tried the signature chicken and waffles (well worth the try) and had something from the sweet side. Definitely worth a try if you're in the area
Danielle is the best bartender! Everyone though is so nice. Great atmosphere, food, and especially drinks
These are very yummy and spicy.The shop is clean and waiters are kind. I think this restaurant is the best Thai restaurant in Alabama!

The menu is such as to excite the pleasures in your mind and make it difficult to pick just one item.  The food is very good and you can be sure it is healthy.  So glad they still offer meat, no vegan here, but I often use some aspects of the practice to curb the calories.  
The staff is always friendly and helpful.

So on the evening of April 9th I went into our favorite Chick-Fil-A for starters no one greeted me took about a good 4 minutes to get anyone's attention, they were all very involved in talking to each other rather than customer service. 
I bring my grandchildren there several times a week. 
When you think of customer service Chick fil a is the top of the scale tonight I got nothing for you. You get a zero and we won't be back for some time. 
No one offered to help me to my table, no one offered me and sauce and kinda ignored me when I asked for some. 
Then they didn't know how to scan my phone so I could get my points and it was a bother for them to help. 
Very disappointed very! 
Not how this place is usually run..

I love Zoe's kitchen, I use to dine in frequently pre covid. They have a ton of options including vegan options. They are diet friendly and offer a good amount of food for the price. 

I always get the steak kabobs with a side of grilled potatoe salad and Greek salad. Their homemade Greek dressing is delicious and you can purchase it separately!

Giving it three stars because I've been ordering takeout through doordash and the food just isn't as good when packaged to go. The grilled potatoe salad comes in tin foil and it's difficult to separate  the foil from the food. The Greek dressing is mainly oil without the seasonings that provide the flavor and its all just slapped in a box. By the time the meat gets to you, it's dry and cold. Don't recommend take out.

I cannot say enough good things about my experience here last night. Not only was it the best German food out of Germany, the place is gorgeous. But the staff. I cannot say enough about our server, I believe his name is shumey? I've noticed in covid culture people are going through kind of a collective trauma. It's hard to go out and be kind to people when we're so sad ourselves. Shumey showed kindness, class, and provided me with such a beautiful experience with socially distanced fun at von Bismarck. He showed me what a food EXPERIENCE could be like for the first time in so long. I've noticed that going out to outdoor restaurants is more of a way of getting out of the house lately, but he showed me that it's more than that. And for that I'll for forever grateful.

Umm so yes go eat here. Foods great, musics great, staff is happy, prices are fair. I don't know how it could get better than that.

My work gets catered lunches from here regularly. The "Crack Bowls" are famous among our office as one of the go-to favorite lunches. With Covid keeping us from the office, I don't get nearly as much of my Food Liason fix as I need!

While the Crack Bowls are the star, don't miss out on their daily specials and baked goods. I had an amazing chipotle shrimp bowl and s'mores cookie my last trip there.

It's a wonderful local establishment and truly the best lunch in the area. I'll be sure to give them my love every time I'm in Carp!

Came in at 10 for dinner on a Saturday night (they close at 11). There were only two tables of people in the entire restaurant & they sat us right next to the other people. We were sitting so close that it was basically like we were sitting together. We could hear all of their conversations. We think they sat us there because they had already cleaned the other tables. We order chicken fajitas & they gave us what looked like scraps of chicken. They gave us barely any chicken at all. The scraps were burnt. They also forgot our tortillas that go with the fajitas & fought us about it. The waitress was very rude & she was also rude to the people sitting next to us. I've been to El Indio & the past & the chicken fajitas normally actually have chicken in them. The place also was not clean. I wouldn't recommend going.

Best Italian I've had in Philadelphia so far. At an outdoor dinner, I enjoyed the classic focaccia (comes with honey butter and bee pollen) and bucatini (a take on cacio e pepe). I highly recommend both! I also had a solid aperol spritz to drink.

For the Covid-19 winter, the restaurant offers outdoor heated seating near Rittenhouse Square.

I will definitely be back to try more items on the menu (or simply reorder the focaccia and bucatini as they were great!).

As a tradition my daughter, grandchildren and I go to breakfast every Saturday. We tried Denny's in Rita Ranch and had a wonderful experience. We had an awesome waiter named Cameron who was very knowledgeable of the menu and very attentive. We enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Thank you Denny's (and Cameron)! We will be back

IF THERE WAS A 6TH STAR ID PUT IT!!
my best friends and I came here and it tasted immaculate !! the food slapped but dude, the employees... AMAZING !! THEY'RE SO NICE AND FUNNY ! we have to come back here like every morning before we leave !
EDIT: we forgot our box of leftovers at the table, and on our 2 minute walk, THE WAITER RAN THE FOOD TO US !! THIS IS TOP TIER SERVICE !

We hadn't been to Hellas for several years and decided it was time to repeat. We had  a 6:30 reservation and arrived on time. Restaurant was about one third full. We waited about 10 min at the desk. Ignored by the one person waiting tables. A second server finally arrived and showed us to a table where we waited, hopeful we would be noticed. The server walked past us several times going to the Bar but alas we were ignored. After being ignored for 25 minutes we left. The second server was busy putting out trash and and as I informed him we were leaving he just said "ok". 
I should have read and heeded the previous reviews. I would have given a zero star rating if it was an option
Awesome place with great staff. This is a great place to eat, grab a coffee, read your bible,  work, or spend time with God.

Sizzling Lunch is a nice place to eat at. It takes a simple idea and executes it very nicely. You're given a plate of your choice of protein along with a base being rice or noodle served on a sizzling plate. You then proceed to sizzle your meal right before you eat it. I got the Kimchi Beef Fried Rice plate. The meat was fresh and the portions were nice. It left me delightfully and not bloated. In addition the restaurant is clean and the staff is attentive and provides good service and gets you in and out rather quickly. I highly recommend.

Being in the restaurant was a different experience compared to most of restaurants here in Reno. Our server Troy made sure that our lunch was fantastic. He was very nice and attentive, we didn't have to look for him or wait for him. I recommend trying it. We really loved it!
The food here is amazing! The brunch is our favorite. The braised "bacon and eggs " is my personal favorite.

I ordered French toast which was delicious!! We also got a side of potatoes, short stack, bacon, Belgian waffles and an orange juice. The bacon was the worst. It was essentially fried fat strips with a little bit of meat. I didn't care because I don't eat bacon but my boyfriend was upset and I agree it didn't look good at all. His waffles were unfortunately soggy but the flavor was good. The short stack was also a disappointment because on grub hub it indicated a short stack of blueberry pancakes and what arrived was 2 buttermilk pancakes. I'm not sure if they were good or not because I didn't bother eating them. The potatoes were undercooked, and also soggy with no flavor and were disappointing. Lastly, the orange juice was delicious!!! 

TLDR: if you want amazing French toast and orange juice (just that, nothing else) this is your place!!

Good pizza overall! Got the veggie which was loaded with lots of yummy seasoned veggies like eggplant. Outdoor seating and easy parking. You must order inside the store. The store itself has so tons of shopping to meet all of your cravings for all things Italian. 

Seems authentic and delicious. While eating outside it was hard to keep bugs away though. Overall would definitely recommend still though. Bathroom was okay. Did not try the desserts but will definitely need to go back for that as the desserts looked pretty amazing! Good for large groups with picnic table seating outside.

Goat yoga was everything. I loved hanging out with the goats. I made a lap goat for about 30 minutes so there was very little yoga done.

The restaurant also has great food and cocktails for after goat yoga. Highly recommend!
Its just flavorless fried Chicken. I guess you have to get it with one of the sauces, but i ordered it plain. And it tasted like deep fried cardboard.

We had the BBQ variety patter for two with  bbq beans and potato salad as sides. And being from Georgia we couldn't pass up the boiled peanuts for our appetizer. Food was great, service was great, will definitely be back

For the prices, I really do expect more than ambiance. The service is excellent. The kitchen needs some serious help. From over dressing salads and using canned veg in the salad, to over salting food while under cooking entrees, and serving a split sauce - there were a lot of rookie mistakes with the food that surprised me. 

If you're in the mood to sit and sit chat over delicious drinks with a few apps - this place is great! If you're looking for a nice spot for a date night where you have impeccable service and mouth watering food - you will be disappointed. 

The ambiance is wonderful. There are tables far enough apart that you don't hear anyone's conversation, and yet close enough that it's not awkward. Everyone had their masks away from the take, and there is sanitizer at the door. Pictures adorn the wall and exposed brick gives that comfy feel I just love. Decorations are limited in a good way, and each table has the white cloth, candle, and comfy chairs so you feel like you're somewhere fancy that still cares about you. 

The servers are genuinely nice and still approachable. The front of house staff was 100% on point. 

The bar looks amazing though we can't sit at those anymore, and the bartender made some delicious cocktails (I recommend the Catherine the Great) as well as picked the perfect wine to accompany dessert. 

Then comes the food. Something is off in the kitchen.  I'm not sure what, but for what dinners cost, I hope they fix the issues quick because they h

SUCH a cute and cool vibe  little place on Magazine St. Our server Jonathan was FABULOUS and made sure My Rum House Punch was kept FULL!!! They were VERY tasty, I might add!!! The Jerk Chicken Quesadillas were very tasty and the Chipotle Shrimp Tacos too were very tasty. Fun Place, will definitely be back!!!

Good mexican food in Franklin TN area. Ordered ToGo at dinner time. The restaurant doesn't support UberEats, and GruhHub would have been late, so offered to pick up curbside... Ordered Comarones a la Diabla (Chipotle Shrimp) and Fajitas Quesadilla with Grilled chicken. Both were perfectly balanced with spices and taste.

This restaurant is in same stripmall where Paletas (Mexican ice-cream place) is!

Monsoon Chocolate is an absolute gem, and one of the most thoughtfully-run businesses I know of in Tucson!

The bonbons are not only lovely to behold, they are all DELICIOUS. It's hard to pick favorites, but I'll list the masala chai (it's vegan!!), the blueberry oat cardamom, and the peaches and  creme fraiche. If you want punchy flavors, they got 'em. If you want smooth, mild classic flavors, they got those too. There are multiple vegan and gluten free options, plus a plethora of chocolate bars to choose from as well. I've learned that pretty much anthing they make with coconut will be exceptional. Support local and treat yo'self!!!!

UPDATE:
I was lucky enough to go on one of their factory tours in 2019, and was astonished to learn that there are only a handful of people who create these delicacies from bean to bar (...to bonbon). They source organic and sustainable ingredients along their entire supply chain, as well as ensure that the cacao farmers they work with make a living wage. Also, I think it's worth mentioning (specifically to the two or three reviews here that are basically people bitching that Monsoon was out of bonbons when they called / drove down...) that these are a HANDCRAFTED ARTISINAL ITEM. There's not a machine churning these things out. There are four or five people meticulously and lovingly perfecting every step of the process, from roasting, grinding, pouring, decorating, creating fillings, covering the bonbons, and who knows how many more things I m

This place is really close to where I live, and it's a cute clean place. The problem I have with it is that (I've only been there twice) both times I got a salad with grilled chicken, the grilled chicken is so tough, it's terrible. Even my mom said; "where did you get this salad, the chicken is so tough". I always give a place a second shot, but sorry, today was it... I gave the chicken to my dog!

Best pizza in Tucson.  The family size is huge and they let you change the toppings by the quarter.  The only draw back is turnaround time; although it is a large pie.  Don't bother asking for it to be prepared at a certain time, they'll just make it when it's convenient for them and leave it on top of the oven until you get there.  This is only frustrating because the pizza won't fit in your home oven to re-heat.

1st time here....wow. I had my 4 year old with me. They set him up with crayons and a drink, answered all his questions, and even asked him about his day. I was already relaxed just being there....they may not have known it but they just entertained my child long enough for me to look at the menu and figure out what to eat. They also explained their process and how allergy friendly they are and their anti cross contamination process. The food was delicious! Their heirloom tomato caprese tastes so fresh.

I don't really care for sandwiches when it comes to eating out but I love the flavored teas.  Super fast to go option if you order online.  I literally just walk in and grab my stuff.  No need to talk to anyone and they haven't gotten my order WRONG.  I can't say that about most places.
Midtown Sushi and Ramen is the best sushi and ramen in Saint Louis. I always get the Spicy Midtown Ramen and the Mr. Miyagi roll. 10/10 every time.

I don't like to give bad reviews but this place just isn't very good. The service is great and the people there are very friendly (which I believe is the real reason Three Brothers receives such great reviews.) 

I have eaten here a few times and was never very impressed but my meal this past weekend was especially disappointing. I don't know how a place can claim to be "authentic Mexican food" when they serve that processed "nacho cheese" you can buy from stores that probably isn't actually cheese. I got nachos and they were coated in the stuff as well as some bland, soupy guacamole that I also suspect was some processed store product. The actual chips were heavily salted and tasted slightly stale. Just not very good at all, overall.

Nothing here seems very fresh or authentic to me. There are better options in the area if you're looking for authentic mexican food.. Three Brothers is fine if you're looking for something quick and cheap.
Great tenderloins. Good beers and on a golf course. Doesn't get any better. Outside tables. Social distancing. Good hang out.
This place is vegan if that is what I like about it in particular. Food is tasty and fresh and that tells you everything you need to know. Come eat here!
I've been coming here regularly and love the seafood so much! Also, the service is friendly, my was always refilled without me having to ask. I highly recommend this place!!

According to my parents, this place is shimply the best!

They have been talking about how great this place is and how awesome the seafood are to my brother and I. Whale finally, they whipped up a delicious dinner for the fam!

They got sea bass and scallops for dinner. I am no expert in seafood or how to cook them but I am an expert at eating it for sure. I have to say, I am all about the bass! I never had it before and it was so yummy. The scallop was great too! Nothing was fishy at all.

I hope you check out this place and have your own amazing seafood dinner with your family. My parents did say they thought the location was odd but just follow the GPS it will definitely lead you to right place. Maybe you'll be as hooked as me and my family once you go. :)

My family and myself went to dinner here for the first time on Saturday night. The atmosphere was very pleasant, live music, lights outside, comfortable spaced out seating and right on the water! All the staff was following social distancing and mask protocols. We were very surprised by our attentive server, Danielle. Being new to Florida we have not had the best experience at other restaurants but she was very attentive, friendly, recommended our dinners and was on top of our drinks! We appreciate that and will be back! The food was amazing too. I highly recommend their salads, turkey club, boneless wings and carnitas tacos! Can you tell everyone loved their meals? Lol.

Only thing I would recommend from the owner is to make sure there is bug spray outside! It is too beautiful at nights to sit inside with your view.
Make sure you triple check, no make that quadruple check, the order before you pay at the register window because they *will* charge you for the wrong order.

I avoided trying Blaze Fast Fire'd Pizza because it was slammed when it first opened. I remember seeing lines down their building to get inside.

The other reason I avoided them until now was because I liked another similar concept restaurant that recently closed called Uncle Maddios and I didn't think they could compare. I'll admit I was wrong  though because Blaze Fast Fire'd Pizza is oh so great and makes 1000 degree Pizza in Spring Hill taste like absolute garbage.

I ordered an 11' pizza online from Blaze Fast Fire'd Pizza and I'm choosing everything I want on it I was in the mood for a white pizza. I got to the bottom of my 10 topping pizza and the price stayed the same. Total cost $9.58! I ordered a classic crust, no sauce, mozzarella, gorgonzola, ovaltine cheese, ricotta, goat cheese, basil, chopped garlic, oregano with mushrooms and olive oil drizzle. 

I was surprised my pizza tasted grea. I noticed  Blaze Fast Fire'd Pizza used whole basil leaves and not little squares of one blended leaf. My pizza wasn't greasy and the cheese stringy. 

When I  picked my pizza up I went to register and they had it ready so, I was in and out very quick. I noticed the restaurant was very clean and the toppings on the line looked fresh. Lots of arrows were on the floor to keep a safe distance from other customers. A new thing their offering is a DIY pizza box to bring home to limit customer exposure. When picking up my to go order, my box was sealed on both ends with red tape and the
The food was amazing and inexpensive. The shrimp poboy was one of the best I've had and the gumbo was delicious. Everybody was super friendly.

The Bartender Sara was amazing. The fall menu is delicious. The craft cocktails are priced amazingly compared to other craft bars I've been to. If you like to play pool there is a pool table in the back to shoot on. There is even a nice sitting place with a fireplace. A must stop by if you are midtown.
Excellent customer service! Waitress was so attentive and even the host and other servers were making sure customers were taken care of! And of course the food was delicious!

My friend and I took the Roux class. We enjoyed making the two main courses including one Gumbo (including a vegetarian version - thanks Teresa for improvising) and the dessert Banana Fosters. Teresa has a great style and make it easy to follow along. I liked her cutting and other prep tips. The food was delicious. We were only four students and the whole experience was great. Looking forward to get back home and try it out.
very good food, we love the char broiler oyster simply a delight.  fast service.  the Lousiana medley very good
Had a couple of IPAs and boss burgers. I substituted garlic parm fries on mine. 10% discount for checking in on yelp. Yeah.

After only one meal, Meadowlark, in New Hope, Pennsylvania, has become my new favorite restaurant.  Because I was with a group that likes to share, I was able to taste a variety of items on the menu.  Unlike many restaurants which seem to serve the same sauce on every dish, each appetizer and main course was unique and delicious.  I ordered the lamb, which was cooked to perfection, but I would have been thrilled to have ordered any of the items on the menu.  I'm normally not much of a dessert eater, but we ordered the chocolate mousse and pana cotta with fresh berries to share, and I am happy that I had a chance to sample them. They definitely were were a great way to finish up an amazing meal.  I look forward to discovering what new dishes will be offered in coming seasons, since the chef offers locally sourced produce.

It's an okay joint. The service was a bit slow in the night of this review. They serve Texas style bbq. A lot of spice and flavor in their sauces and sides. Small place with a bar inside. There's probably better bbq places in Nashville, but I haven't found them yet. I wish the portion sizes were a bit larger, but then again maybe I'm being overzealous.

I play at silver legacy alot and have alot of offers for a free room and free play everytime I call they want to charge me ...and they put me on hold for 20 minutes .
I am so ready to start going back to play at peppermill 
Feelimg very frustrated

My husband ordered a birthday cake for me with instructions to have buttercream frosting.
The cake was 4 layers and topped with the most delicious buttercream frosting I have ever had.  The cake was moist and delicious. It was also decorated beautifully.
It was so awesome that I couldn't stop eating it.  My friends and family also said it was the best.  
I am telling everyone what a wonderful bakery it is.
Unfortunately I have not had the opportunity to try their other offerings and plan on a visit very soon

Absolutely lovely !
I'd highly recommend the tacos and the grilled grouper. 
The service was on point, the view ; priceless.
Food was yummy and portion sizes were huge. Live music as well.  Very chill. The review is saying my review is too short so ai'm writing about it.

this is a delivery : 

it was my 1st time w aromatic rice which was nice but ruined by the too heavy smell of vinegar esp I think what I think was coleslaw I cldnt get near it for the vinegar smell 

the kabobs & the pita were ok but the hummus is also a bite of vinegar 

do we see a trend here? lol not worth the price

For a high end quality Japanese experience, Morimoto has long been a consistent bet in the city, though for a birthday last night, their was a failure to hit the mark. We had among several appetizers, the 90 dollar sushi chef combo, but unlike many times in the past, where the combo had several fish selections, this combination was basically shrimp, tuna, salmon, and amber jack. 

Along with a couple of rolls, spicy tuna, hamachi scallion, and a tuna avocado, this combination failed to hit the variety mark we had typically come to expect.  

Little details were also dropped on a service level, which dampened the experience including the need to ask for wasabi and ginger, and soy.  

Perhaps it's nit picky, but at Morimoto, I don't think I should have to ask for the above items, is it not understood?

Finally, I sat at our table with empty water and wine glasses for roughly 20 minutes before our server ever noticed.  Perhaps a transgression like this could be overlooked elsewhere, but for Morimoto brand, this is simply unacceptable.

Leaving the restaurant, I felt worse that upset, it was disappointment.
I got the turkey and it was great! they were out of burnt ends tho so I'll be headed back soon and hopefully can bump it up to 5 stars!

This is the best carry out Chinese restaurant that I have been to.  The food is excellent, and the staff are very friendly.  I appreciate all the options that they offer including Chinese, Japanese, and Thai dishes.  You can get lo mein instead of white rice with many dishes for a slight charge.  They also offer a bucket of fried rice which my kids love.  I have ordered from them many times in the previous few months and have never been disappointed.

Yes, yes, and yes. Go! Don't let strip mall exterior deter you. Family-owned and elegant. I've been a regular for over 20 years. Again, go! Best Thai soup offerings at lunch. You can't find better Fried Rice or Pad Thai in STL.

I have been going to Little Italy for decades.  This place is an institution.  If you like New York style pizza, this is where you get it.  You can also get great sandwiches/subs/grinders/hoagies.

Like the Terminator, I'll be back.
Great little spot in Spring City, behind the Burger King. The food is great and the people that work there are the kindest!!

Long story short I ordered the Bourbon plate and I've been trying to get back ever since! The best damn food I've had in a while, the staff is super nice. I was not expecting such good food and great service

RRR, my son and I got carry out on a Saturday night.   We all got the same thing, Dupbop with chicken and purple rice except I had tofu.  We were all disappointed with our meals. 

What we liked:  the tofu and the chicken were nicely cooked as was the rice.  The dumplings were fine. 

What needs improvement for us:  Less rice and a lot more vegetables.   Options such as various sauces would be great.  Also,  we expected real purple rice (black rice) but it appeared to be white rice with a bit of sauce.  I know most Korean cooking has a mix of black rice and short grain but i couldn't spot any purple.

BEST Boba smoothies! They even offer real fruit! I haven't tried their food to judge. The restaurant is very cleanly, offers entertainment (HUGE fish tank, TV w firestick, bar-like seating) while waiting and has a modern/funky touch. The ladies behind the counter are always so nice! One time getting smoothies, my boyfriend dropped it while walking out. The woman offered to make a new one without us even asking, great customer service!

We had our last meal of our trip to Clearwater here and to quote my husband "I'm so glad we didn't eat here the first day because we wouldn't have gone anywhere else." It's true...the food was so fresh and phenomenal! Don't expect any frills here...it's truly a bait house that you walk through and they have tables in the back, situated right over the water. The views are amazing, the folks who work there are so friendly, and again...THE FOOD! We had the drunken shrimp and the catch of the day Reuben with mahi mahi (fresh catch was mahi mahi or wahoo.) The drunken shrimp is something anyone who sets foot in Clearwater should experience. A generous amount of shrimp in a bowl smothered in a DELICIOUS creole-style sauce and served with crusty, toasty ciabatta bread pieces to soak up all the goodness. The Reuben was also excellent...I love a good classic Reuben and would never think to have it with fish. It was outstanding and the mahi mahi was so fresh, the fillet was perfectly flaky and tender. We were with our toddler and the kids menu there had more than enough options. Just two quirks to note if you're going with toddlers...they do not have high chairs or straws, so bring your own cup and try to get a table with chairs vs. one of the high tops. It was really no big deal for us though and she was happy with her meal and the location as well. We plan to return to Clearwater for future vacations and will definitely be back to Bait House!

I have eaten here for years through all the name changes the food has been consistently delicious but recently I feel the quality is not what it once was.  Today was not royal Indians best day   I had to beg for naan bread which when I received it all I got two small cold pieces. Also the pakora was cold and soggy. The service was not the usual friendliness I am used to here. Overall i won't be back for awhile. Next time I'm in the mood for Indian at lunch I will try the new takeout place down the street by tj maxx
Burger was good but definitely not a $10 burger but the fries are really good. All in all it was a ok meal.

Went there for dinner.  My wife had chicken Parm, I had stuffed shrimp, and my son had your cheeseburger. My son and I both agree that it was the best cheeseburger we've ever tasted. Who would've thought a seafood restaurant would have an excellent cheeseburger.

All the food and service was very good. But that cheeseburger,, wow the cheeseburger!!!

The butter garlic sauce is the single most delicious thing in the universe and I did indeed practically drink it. Ordered delivery and can't wait to come dine in. Hoping to fix some of the hole Nauti Mermaid has left behind!

Bordertown has a restaurant inside called The Kafana, and it has so many food options. Due to the pandemic, I did a phone order, for takeout for my family! I spoke to Michelle who took my family's order. 
There are steak options, pasta option, sandwich options, burger options and even Mexican options.
Tonight we tried the appetizer sampler which included chicken wings with a choice of sauce; We did hit wings! Jalapeño poppers, fried zucchini, and mozzarella sticks. We all had our favorite and mine was the mozzarella sticks. My fiancé liked the jalapeño poppers and my little one liked the fried zucchini. 
The meals we chose were the the Philly cheesesteak and fries for my fiancé, I had the salmon and the side options I chose were rice and salad, and my little one had the spaghetti and we added meatballs. The kids spaghetti cane with garlic toast and Parmesan cheeses. 
There were a few problems that made our takeout experience a little disappointing. And I hate to be negative but there we're several things that made my review the 3 stars it is. Half of our food was either undercooked, overcooked, or missing. The chicken wings were raw in the middle, as were the meatballs in my little one's spaghetti, my salmon was very dry and was missing seasoning like basic salt and pepper, and we did not receive the salad that came with my meal. 
To end on a positive note, we loved our chocolate, strawberry and vanilla milkshakes.They were smooth, creamy, and perfect thickness! 
I'm hoping t

The place has been really busy recently and looks to be a little short staffed right now. Be patient with them and they will help you out when they can. I know my order was canceled really close to that dinner rush time, 6pm last Wednesday. No worries, cause I will be back again when I catch them at an earlier time 

The rolls that I love are the Crunch roll and Crazy roll. Don't forget to get their Miso soup and House Salad andddd the ice cream mochi for desert
Came back for Easter weekend.  Amazing!  Love this place.  Had a fantastic time, perfect weather for a special occasion. With my loved one .

Did a carry out order of Meat Me in St Louis. Everybody mentions how huge they are but seem the normal size I was used to when I lived in a Brownsburg. It was ok but nothing to rave about. Found the pre selected options priced higher than I was used to. I guess I long for a independently owned shop. Like I've had other places. Best Calzone I've had was in little town of North Salem $7.99 for calzone their

With all of the positive reviews, I had really high hopes for Crispy Cajun walking in. I was happy to see the menus posted in the windows outside making it super easy for a first timer like myself to review all of my options (because the menu is quite lengthy!) prior to even entering the establishment. I ordered some fried chicken and a shrimp/fish dinner. My initial thought was whoa $26! But once I got home, I realized just how generous their portions were. My order consisted of: 6 fried shrimp, 2 pcs. of fried catfish, red beans and rice, cole slaw, mashed potatoes, 4 non-organic pcs. of fried chicken and an array of sauces. It was more than enough for 2 people!

When I placed my order, I asked for mashed potatoes in lieu of french fries. I wish I was informed this would be an extra charge. I also kind of wish the mashed potatoes had some taste. It was missing salt, butter, everything? It was pretty bland and not even worth the extra charge. I was so disappointed. The chicken on the other hand was HOT HOT HOT! It was so crispy and fresh! They definitely hit the mark on this one. Now if only the shrimp and fish were equally crispy and fresh. The seafood tasted like it was frozen and reheated in the fryer, then left out for awhile. It wasn't even room temperature once I dug into it. I was totally let down! 

Would I return? Maybe. But only for the chicken.

Ok so I was a little nervous I must say. Never had Indian food before. I listened to my neighbor. Thanks Dave. It was awesome. I had the Butter Chicken. Excellent. I also got the rice pudding dessert. Little different taste then regular rice pudding but also very good. I'll be back again for sure.
The pita bread wasn't actually pita bread. It was more like a burrito wrap. Other than that the food was great.

So stinking delicious. I still can't shake the thought of the Pork Belly Pizza with a fried egg.  Soo good....

The cauliflower salad was unexpected and delicious. For entree, we ordered the roasted chicken that came on a bed of chickpeas with a green sauce. Unfortunately neither of us like seafood and that green sauce had a strong anchovy flavor, so it kind of ruined that dish for us. 

We finished with an incredibly balanced cake that seemed to be their take on Tiramisu and we loved every bite. 

Overall, we'll be back for everything except the chickpeas-  SOON!

Been skeptical about going out to eat, but family wanted something different then fast food. Right away we felt comfortable here, they had a temperature station out front & required masks to enter (provided if needed), once at table was able to remove. Tables were spaced for social distancing and all the hostesses, and staff wore masks & gloves. Gina (our hostess) explained what steps were being taken to ensure customer & staff safety (like disposable menus, use once & recycling bin it goes).  So definitely taking precautions to ensure a safe dining in experience.
     Now on to the food, it was incredible !!! We rolled with our Hostess suggestions & everything was amazing & delicious.  We did some Spicy Ramen which was just the right amount of spicy. We also did a large Sashimi tray which had some of the best & freshest pieces of fish that I have had ever. Gina also suggested asparagus sushi roll which was surprising scrumptious.  Everything about our dining experience in these difficult times was superb, from our hostess to each dish we ate- Just a great establishment with amazing food & a friendly atmosphere.
Very delicious pizza and quick "grab-and-go" place or dine-in too. We have the pepperoni and garlic knots.

The staff was very friendly. Service was very fast and I loved the containers and the way the drinks are covered. 
I loved the lavender lemonade. My husband was not crazy about the passion mango tea.  I would visit again!
Go alone, sit at the counter facing the kitchen, order their hush puppies!

The Music is offensive and overly loud coming from this Friday's I'm all for a good time but this is excessive. The language is offensive, not only from the music but from the DJ. This just isn't necessary. Really it's just the volume. Turn it down.
AMAZING! Loved the flavor and quality of the seafood. Came with garlic bread to start. Also ordered the crab cakes. Can't go wrong with any menu item. Will definitely return!

I stumbled upon this place looking for a place to eat after shopping. I was pleasantly surprised with their food. I was hoping to get some guidance while ordering, so that part I was a tad bit lost. It would be great if they could have explained it better. 
Now, on to the important stuff, the food. There were 3 of us and it was enough for us to share a little of everything. We got the cassava fries which were tasty.  The falafels were great. Normally when I have them at other places, they tend to dry and hard. These were moist, flavorful and easy to eat!   The chicken wings were also very good. We also had the chicken and rice with was very good also. The sauces are great.  If you want to try some different flavors, give this place a try. I hope they stick around because I would definitely come back again.

China Kitchen is now down to one star.  Pretty sad.  Luncheon specials are now w down to half the size they used to be. It appears it is under new management.  Very sad.  End of an era!

I'm downgrading my review from 5 stars to 2 stars.  Every time I come in here I get scowled at by the lady behind the counter.  Look I know you hate your life:  but I am the customer!  This means smiling!  This means greeting me!  The food is OK but to be honest it's not that great and they are getting more expensive!  Want a better review!  Smile at me.  Be nice to me.  Or I'm going someplace else there are now other choices!

TLDR: The restaurant is yuppie hipster gastropub. The food is a bit more upscale than your typical gastropub. The cocktails are excellent. Be warned though, your entire party must be present before you will be seated.

In a time where restaurants need business Chuy's is really failing. This is the second time my wife and I have tried to order from Chuy's and both times we get a looping voicemail on the phone to order online and their online ordering is down. 

Update: tried again and we did get food, it was pretty delicious too, they messed up our order but we got free margs out of it so I am not complaining. I'll update this more next time. I recommend the nacho party kit!

It was late but I'm glad this place was open for indoor dining plus I wanted hibachi. I realized that afterward that the hibachi experience wasn't available due to Covid but I can still order the hibachi dinner on the menu. I got the steak and salmon with vegetables and fried rice. I wanted noodles instead of rice but they couldn't substitute so I decided to get a side of noodles as well. The rice was ok, a little bland for my taste. The noodle was not that good. Don't recommend. The salmon and steak were cooked well.

I also got the tuna dumplings which is my favorite!! Highly recommend. I also got otoro sushi and Kobe sushi from their special menu. Very good. The quality of the fish and the meat were great! Also got a sushi platter that has salmon, eel, tuna, and yellowtail with some California rolls. Love the variety of the rolls and sushi. 

I would come here again for other items on the menu. Wish next time there is a hibachi experience but I understand due to covid there are limitations

Horrible experience tonight with take out. Ordered to go and didn't receive half of my order. Called to let them know and they hung up right when they answered the phone because it was almost closing time. I wouldn't recommend this place at all. Horrible service as well! Spoke to the owner today and he was very rude. Asked every question about the meal and asked me why I ordered it the way I did. He argued with me about all of it. Told me he would give me a gift card but I told him I wanted a refund and he said I am not doing that. Horrible customer service and the owner doesn't deserve any business.  Save yourself a trip and just go somewhere else.

After moving to Carmel over 3.5 years ago my wife and I have never been able to find a Thai restaurant whose food motivated us to go back for a second visit. Well, the search was ended when we ordered carry-out from Thai Castle!  We ordered Pad Thai - one order of chicken, the other with shrimp. The food tasted fresh and had the perfect blend of ingredients.  The portions were also very generous and everything was hot when we got home.  Did I mention the the order was ready in 15 minutes? We look forward to trying more items on their menu in the near future.

We stopped here for breakfast and got a sweet and savory crepe. The blueberry crepe was filled with cream cheese yogurt and had massive blueberries with a delicious house made granola. The bacon #3 crepe my husband got tasted a lot like a yummy cheese pizza. Their organic coffee is also amazing with a lot of different flavor options. Must-go breakfast stop in St. Louis.

I was very hungry and my friend suggested this place for soup. We got a table right away for dinner. I noticed the cups for water smelled like cleaning products and plastic. We had to flag our waiter for ordering, more water, and for the bill. I got the wrong type of noodles, but they fixed it right away for me so that was good. The food was amazing, especially the soup! I hope they can find better service and a different way for cleaning their cups...
Food 10/10
Service 4/10

2/3/20. Sunrise Eatery
 Great food and good service. Apparently, they had to expand to another building because they were so successful. A lot of people ordered milkshakes around me, but I couldn't afford the extra calories,  although they look great! We all had sandwiches and the portions were very big, so you will not go home hungry- One of their sayings. The clientele was Retired and the help was young so don't let us old people scare you off!  Definitely worth the stop.

Used to like this place years ago when the food was pretty good. Trying to serve a black woman old, dried out, so much sauce I hope they can't taste how old the wings are, chicken ain't right. Dining in usually means freshly cooked food, but not here anymore.
This is a great place to eat sushi with a fun ambiance.  The Jalapeño Tuna Tataki helps my craving for the same dish at NOBU.  Never had a bad meal and the lunch special is a heck-of-a-deal.

Really enjoyed the food! 
The chicken pho was on point the broth was one of the best I have had- super delicious... the guy next to me ordered the beef broth and that smelled even more delicious... next time

The corn chowder is worth it alone. Thankfully, it's just one of many delicious things on their menu. The burgers are bomb. The salads are superb. And those tater tots are terrific! Can't say enough about this spot.

Wow. First time visiting after living down the road for 3 years. Placed was packed Saturday night at 7, but was seated in less than a minute.  Good service.  Blueberry sangria was delicious and refreshing.  We had one house and one Ceasars salad, both delicious.  The bread loaves with butter and garlic are to die for. I had the seafood combo over linguini in the white wine sauce. Magnificent.  Took half home. My wife ordered veal parm and spaghetti.  Huge piece of veal and the red sauce was delicious.  Took half home. Chocolate fudge cake for desert. Made in NY and big enough for two. It was so good, we had no problem finishing it. Will 100 percent return. Would of given 5 stars but the bench seat was so tall, you could not enjoy your meal. The bench runs the entire wall, and everyone was complaining.  Easy fix, just bite the bullet and get it done.

If you enjoy fried and savory food, you MUST try WEPA! It's difficult to find authentic Puerto Rican food in the US, and WEPA is the real deal. 

I ordered the chicharrones de pollo, which is essentially fried chicken with a crispy pork rine skin. It was delicious but extremely heavy, so make sure to go there hungry! The tostones were also perfect. They were just the right balance of salty and crispy. 

Overall, it was incredible, I can't wait to go back!

This place is......
Awesome. Had filet, Pete's Manhattan with ginger ale chaser. I don't eat mushrooms,so they substituted a different sauce. Everything, including service was excellent. I sat at bar, bar tenders were very attentive, and as I said, all food was exceptional. 
You really can't go wrong here. I ordered steak because I'm from Midwest and was jonesing for meat.
But they're seafood is beyond comparison. I love this place, and visit it st least once every time I'm in area. ( sand key location).
I love this restaurant! The food has always been sooo good and i've never been disappointed. This is my favorite place to go to for Thai food in Santa Barbara :) Thank you for being open!

Ok. So hidden gem here, folks! To say this is a pizza place is underestimating it, for sure. I am sure the pizza is fantastic, but the homemade absolutely delicious italian food is what we had. Try the cioppino, the linguini with clams, the meatball sub, the antipasto salad, and for heavens sake, save room for the desserts! The food was fantastic. Service was friendly, personable, fun, and attentive. Do not miss out on this one!

Looking for some fresh burgers? Look no more! This spit is not something you would notice driving by but I heard about it on social media so decided to go give it a try. They currently do not have indoor seating so all food is given to-go. I got the double cheeseburger and fries. Be prepared to wait as it is made to order fresh! Condiments are on a table for you to doctor up your burger or fries. You can ask for ketchup packets but i do Wish they had packets of mustard available instead of the bottle that everyone else uses. Make sure you add the Cajun seasoning to your fries! The burger was huge, juicy and well seasoned. I couldn't finish the whole meal.

Being korean I need my Korean fill once a week. I have only tried Joo joo, Seoul garden, Tony's and one other bbq place which I don't  remember its name(not worth mentioning). I have read about Sos, but I had never been and someone recently recommended this restaurant, so I finally made it out for pick up during this Covid season. 
1)Ddukboki: best I have had in STL and even including Chicagoland area. It is spicy though...
2)bulgogi kimbop and veggie Kimbop: I also like their kimbop better than East East grocery and even two other places I get kimbop in Chicago burbs. Bulgogi one tastes better but I was happily surprised they put burdock in the veggie one. They r a little too large in size but very fresh!
3)bulgogi bowl-D-E-Licious!!! It comes with glass noodles and rice with some spicy mayo like sauce.
4)seafood pancake- it looks good but it was bland, like it needed salt and the dipping sauce needed more sweetness (Joojoo's better)
5)Kimchee jigae-good amount of tofu and pork. It tastes very satisfactory!
6)spicy pork bowl-very tasty, also comes with glass noodles and rice plus cabbage and special sauce 
7)prices seem reasonable as they give u large po

I don't expect much from fast food but this Jack in the box is awful!!  I've only been there 3 times and the first time my son wouldn't eat his burger because he said it tasted old, the second time they forgot 2 things in my order and now they gave me a burnt sandwich and fries that are cold and hard an unbeatable. . I think they just reheat old food. Next time I will just drive down the street to Wendy's
Excellent service delicious food was there celebrating my children birthday they love it thank i you n keep up the good work

I love this place! My family used to own restaurants and I'm a tough critic. The sandwiches, prepared foods and desserts are phenomenal. You can also get a wide array of imported items. They also sell coffee from an Italian coffee roaster in Philadelphia that is absolutely amazing.

The first time I came here was OK, but my second and most recent experience was miserable. My husband and I made reservations. They were late to seat us. When they did seat us, we were in front of a glass window and wind blew threw the windows heavily. We politely asked if we could change seats and the hostess told us "that's a no." I wore a North Face parka through the whole dinner and we rushed to leave. Food was OK, but very overpriced and we couldn't enjoy it because there was no heating. And it's February. In Pennsylvania.

I saw this place from someone else's social media, and I knew I had to have a sushi burrito for myself! I've been about 10 times now with my friend and it never disappoints! I've never had the regular sushi or ramen from here, so this review is only for the sushi burrito.

First of all, I know a lot of people complain about how confusing this place is. Since I've never eaten in the back, I always know how to do the line. You go in line and kind of like Chipotle, you customize your burrito! I always get a burrito with white rice, spicy tuna/salmon, sesame seeds, eel sauce, cucumber, seaweed salad, avocado, and tempura crunch! It's basic but I don't like it over veggied. I believe the seaweed salad and the avocado are extra money, but to me it's always worth it!

Two small complaints about this place I could think of. 1, last time my boyfriend and I came he wanted to get tempura chicken as his protein and they had none! We didn't see it on the counter and the labeled tray was empty. Unfortunately, he doesn't like seafood too much so he didn't enjoy his burrito. But, we're definitely going to try again because I am not letting him dislike this place!! 2, sometimes the staff seems very confused. I've gotten great staff that are super quick with it and know what they are doing. However, sometimes you get someone and it seems like it's their first day. They take their time with it, which can be agonizing when you're hungry!! Either way, these are not reasons to turn down awesome fo

Carnivores, vegetarians, and vegans unite! A pizza place to satisfy all comers. I had the slice and salad lunch special. Thin, crispy crust with pepperoni. Not bad for a thin crust. Next time I'll try the fresh out-of-the-oven kind. I enjoyed the salad more this time. Lots of greens of Red Leaf Lettuce, Red Onions, "Baco" Bits, sliced Hot Peppers, Tomatoes, Croutons and SP Vegan Ranch Dressing. 

We had our order within 15 minutes quickly, but my daughter and her friend ordered their full sized pizzas before we arrived and my husband and I had finished our meal before their pizzas arrived. And my husband is the slowest eater on the planet. 

We will try again to eat here and hopefully enjoy a 5 Star Visit instead of a 3.5-4 Star visit.

From the bus boys to the owners this place is amazing can't believe that it isn't packed from open to closed. We had kat and Maura as our servers and they were fantastic. 

Highly recommend the friend calamari

I had such high expectations! Unfortunately, most fell short. We felt very rushed the entire time. We arrived at 6:30. By 6:45 our food was already arriving at our table. The "best selling" crispy cauliflower was nothing special - plain, undercooked, and poorly seasoned. Pastas were good but Americanized. The bread was served alone without any sort of oil which, in my Italian opinion, is one of the most important aspects! The only saving grace were our cocktails and desserts. The "Alto" was quite tasty. The flourless chocolate cake very rich.
